### Research

- **Disentangling the Cosmic Web** [2026]{.cvdate}
  - Focus: The Relationship Between Walls and Other Cosmic Structures
  - Built an automated pipeline using Python, Globus, DisPerSE, and ParaView to extract and quantify walls, filaments, and clusters from a Quijote N-body simulation (134-million-particles tiled into 40 blocks to fit in memory)
  - Found that ~99% of filaments lie within walls and that walls hold ~51% of all particles at z = 0, showing that walls are structurally fundamental to the cosmic web
  - Regeneron International Science and Engineering Fair Finalist
  - Project website: [https://efuleky27.github.io/disperse/](https://efuleky27.github.io/disperse/)

- **Primordial Black Holes and Dark Matter** [2025]{.cvdate}
  - Focus: The Link Between the Early Universe and Modern Cosmology
  - Gathered 10 published observational limits and numerically integrated them to find the largest share of dark matter that primordial black holes could account for: ~30.5% under the strictest set.
  - Hawaii State Science Fair Finalist
